about: Witnesses for the question in START.md. 'situation' is model/revisions.py's vocabulary: the record's kind and state, the action, what revision the request states (current / last = the one the record had when it was erased / older / none) and, for a confirmed action, whether the one-time confirmation value is fresh or used up. status: accepted = an accepted passage gives the outcome directly; derived = follows from several accepted passages (derivation given); open = the texts admit several outcomes (the question). 'preserve' is fixed BEFORE any patch is checked: true = every patch must keep this outcome; false = a patch may change or decide it.

witnesses.title: Retry of a customer erasure after a lost answer
witnesses.admissible_because: the owner's form is resubmitted after a lost answer (A01's Consequence counts 'a resubmitted owner form' among the events Registry meets); the erasure asks for no confirmation [q:ID.confirmed], so the resubmission reaches the revision check; it carries the revision of the card it rendered [q:A04.consequence]
witnesses.initial: Customer C recorded, corrected once (revision 2), then erased by a request stating 2 — the answer lost
events: owner: erase C's contact data stating revision 2 (the same form, resubmitted)
witnesses.observer: the owner: whether the interface says done or asks to reload

witnesses.title: A second tab, older than the erasure, erases again
witnesses.admissible_because: several owner sessions may be open at once [q:A13.r2.sessions]; each tab sends the revision of the card it rendered [q:A04.consequence]
witnesses.initial: C at revision 1 shown in tab A; tab B corrects C (revision 2) and erases it stating 2
events: owner, tab A: erase C stating revision 1
witnesses.note: R0-35 would call revision 1 'older' and revision 2 not; Registry cannot tell them apart, because the erased Customer keeps no revision [q:M04.erased] [q:R0-06.nothing_else]. Every reading answers W01 and W02 alike.

witnesses.title: Erasing an erased customer, stating no revision
witnesses.admissible_because: the owner reads an erased Customer as its customer_ref and the erased mark [q:M04.read_erased]; a request built from that card states none [q:A04.r3]
events: owner: erase C stating no revision

witnesses.title: Restricting an erased customer, stating no revision
events: owner: restrict C stating no revision

witnesses.title: Restricting an erased customer from a stale card
witnesses.admissible_because: two owner sessions [q:A13.r2.sessions]: the card shown before the erasure in one, the erasure made in the other
witnesses.initial: C at revision 2 shown in tab A; tab B erases C
events: owner, tab A: restrict C stating 2
witnesses.observer: the owner: 'reload' or 'this customer was erased'

witnesses.title: Correcting an erased customer from a stale card
events: owner, tab A: correct C stating 2

witnesses.title: Archiving again from a card older than the archive
witnesses.admissible_because: two owner sessions; the confirmation step shown in the second session after the first archived
witnesses.initial: P at revision 2 shown in tab A; tab B archives P (revision 3)
events: owner, tab A: archive P stating 2, with a fresh confirmation

witnesses.title: Archiving an archived project with its current revision
Erasing a customer from a stale card before any erasure
witnesses.initial: C at revision 1 in tab A; tab B corrects C (revision 2)
events: owner, tab A: erase C stating 1

witnesses.title: Erasing a customer with its current revision
witnesses.observer: the owner; the audit log gains one entry (A14)

witnesses.title: Anonymising again from another session's step
witnesses.admissible_because: two owner sessions; the step in session 1 was shown for the archived project at revision 3, bound to it [q:A13.r6.bind]; session 2 anonymised it
witnesses.initial: P archived at revision 3; session 1 shows the erasure step; session 2 anonymises P
events: owner, session 1: submit the step (anonymise, stating 3)

witnesses.title: Retrying a project erasure in the same session
witnesses.admissible_because: a lost answer; the step's one-time value was used up by the first submission [q:A13.r6.used]
witnesses.initial: P anonymised by a submission whose answer was lost

witnesses.title: Deleting an anonymised project whole from another session's step
witnesses.admissible_because: as W11, the owner having chosen deletion in the step

witnesses.title: Anonymising an anonymised project, stating no revision
events: owner: anonymise P stating none, confirming

witnesses.title: Deleting an anonymised project whole, stating no revision
events: owner: delete P whole stating none, confirming

witnesses.title: Correcting a customer without stating a revision (mirror case)
witnesses.admissible_because: a malformed request; the owner interface always sends one, so only a direct request reaches this
events: owner: correct C stating no revision
